title: The coord hook's SessionStart line in a plugin workspace names paths that exist only in the kb clone, and an Edit or Write event shows asks
goal: the hook's SessionStart line names commands that run in a plugin workspace (the plugin root's coord.py and kbask.py), and a PreToolUse event of Edit or Write only renews the presence lease, as gate g3 of ST-omimwr5q and kb/_self/coordination.md say

run:
import re, sys
src = open('.claude/hooks/coord_hook.py', encoding='utf-8').read()
intro = src[src.index('INTRO = ('):src.index('FOOTER = (')]
pre = src[src.index('def pre_tool'):] if 'def pre_tool' in src else src
paths_ok = 'CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT' in intro or '{coord}' in intro or '{tools}' in intro or 'python3 _tools/' not in intro
edit_quiet = not re.search(r'Edit\W{0,6}Write[^\n]{0,200}\n[^\n]{0,200}show\(', src)
print('INTRO names a path that exists in a plugin workspace:', paths_ok, '| Edit or Write event shows no asks:', edit_quiet)
sys.exit(0 if paths_ok and edit_quiet else 1)
